excluded_private_material: All original evidence, source copies, private driver and fixtures, mock payloads, snapshots, runtime directories, journals and recovery state remain excluded from public delivery.
preservation_contract: At each newly observed PR head, exact selected QUEUE Status claimed_solved plus phase administration gates precede candidate or original evidence reads; claimed Contents is bound to exact-head immediate Merkle trees.

Original native candidate, update manifest, actual application, original source-head first review and actual updated-head second review remain independently byte-pinned and joined; no replacement reviewed manifest is invented.

Original published PDF and two ZIP payload hashes are immutable. Integration changes only accepted-row DOI and Findings, then transplants the accepted entire selected row into latest bound main QUEUE while preserving every other main byte.
Immediate nonrecursive Merkle trees preserve opaque untouched main subtrees; original outside-scope branch changes and unresolved selected conflicts stop without mutation.

Durable fsynced intents and action/head claims precede writes; one nonforce ref update, explicit readiness and expected-SHA ordinary merge, with GET-only uncertainty reconciliation and no blind retry.

Final certification joins actual merged PR and actual merge-parent/main ancestry with exact selected bytes, actual DOI row and unchanged unrelated main content; drift preserves truthful historical metadata without packet certification.
safety_boundaries_and_remaining_gaps: Root must inspect actual two full-package reviews, native publication tool receipt/source, exact payload pins, native Sheet values.batchGet readback and the resulting evidence binding document before any live plan or apply.
Synthetic native receipt examples establish schema behavior, not authenticity, actual mathematical correctness, reviewer independence or live publication/Sheet state.
GitHub readiness has no atomic expected-head condition: exclusive branch control is required; post-response headRefOid checking records races and prevents merge but cannot undo readiness.

GitHub merge has expected-head binding but no atomic expected-main condition; preflight stops detected main drift and final verification uses the actual first parent to certify any unrelated late main advance.
Root must execute and inspect a fresh concrete GET-only plan using authentic original evidence and current exact head/main before separately authorized remote mutation.
A changed main after integration or any unresolved preservation ambiguity stops the helper; it does not automatically manufacture new review/application evidence or bypass mergeability.
